parts.name: Become a HERO
parts.desc: Goal: 35. After an ally monster attacks and kills an enemy monster, gain a counter for all excess DMG dealt. After you summon {Pixel Kris} or {White Cloak} gain 5 counters. Reward: Equip _The Shadow Mantle_.

parts.name: The Shadow Mantle
parts.desc: After an ally monster attacks and kills an enemy monster, gain a counter for all excess DMG dealt. Turn end: Draw a card and give it +1/+1 for every 3 counters this has and lose all counters. If this had 9+ counters, also give it Darkspawn. Shock: Add a {Friendling} to the enemy deck.

parts.name: Mantle Holder
parts.desc: Haste. Darkspawn. Quest: _Become a HERO_. Magic and Turn start: Add a {Friendling} to the top of the enemy deck.

parts.name: Friendling
parts.desc: Darkspawn. Magic: Draw a card (Except {Friendling}). Dust: If this was killed by an enemy monster, give it Candy.
